description: Fundamental (financial) data truth matrix for BIST after R2-073. Every cell is either a REAL, runtime-verified data point or an explicit absence (null / UNAVAILABLE / PARTIALLY_AVAILABLE) with provenance. Technical indicators are NEVER fundamental inputs. Fintables is the only provider that implements fetchFundamentalData; it is NOT_CONFIGURED, so the production financial dimension is UNAVAILABLE until credentials are supplied and runtime-verified.

1_fintables.evidence: no FINTABLES_* keys in .env; live unauthenticated probe to https://fintables.com/api/v1/health returned HTTP 403 (2026-08-17T19:14:39Z)
1_fintables.adapter: fintables-unified.adapter.ts implements fetchFundamentalData; validateConnection() returns false when no apiKey (line 68)

2_kap.evidence: kap.adapter.ts exposes company + disclosures only; no financial statements, ratios, or balance-sheet fields

3_verified_integrated_sources.evidence: no other provider implements fetchFundamentalData; base-provider.adapter.ts default returns null (line 193)

4_public_research.evidence: serpapi/google research is never promoted to authoritative financial truth

yahoo.evidence: R2-072 runtime probe 10/10 TRY quotes; yahoo-unified.adapter.ts getFinancialRatios/getBalanceSheet/getIncomeStatement all return null

netProfitPrevious.note: fintables single-period endpoint does not provide prior period; kept null (no fabrication)

metadataFields.availableAt: present; = retrievedAt when provider gives no period dates; point-in-time guard: data usable only when availableAt <= signalTimestamp
metadataFields.periodEndDate: null until a provider exposes fiscal period end
metadataFields.announcementDate: null until a provider exposes announcement date

scoreSemantics.weights: UNCHANGED (opportunity.config: financial 20, technical 20, confluence 25, smartMoney 20, marketStructure 15; elite-score.config: financial 25, technical 25, opportunity 20, confluence 15, candidate 15; candidate.config: financial 30, technical 30, confluence 40)
scoreSemantics.thresholds: UNCHANGED (DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS and score grade thresholds untouched)
scoreSemantics.scoreEngineTotalWeight: sum of weights of rules with status != UNAVAILABLE
scoreSemantics.neutralFabrication: REMOVED: missing data never yields 50/0/neutral default; absence is excluded from composites and normalized over available dimensions
scoreSemantics.financialDimensionExclusion: opportunity/candidate/confluence/elite engines exclude a UNAVAILABLE financial dimension from weighted composites and confidence averages

technicalVsFundamental.now: explicit { score:0, grade:'D', dataStatus:'UNAVAILABLE', isValid:false }; financialAlignment { score:0, direction:'neutral', confidence:0, factors:['Financial data unavailable'] }
technicalVsFundamental.smaAsConfluence: allowed (confluence/technical dimensions are technical by design)

smartMoney.live: computed from real OHLCV (accumulation/distribution); empty result = zeros with isValid=false; NO hardcoded 50/30

pointInTimeIntegrity.implementation: availableAt now carried on FundamentalData/FundamentalProfile; historical-backtest dataAtT filters timestamp <= T (candles); fundamentals in backtest are UNAVAILABLE so no PIT leak

fakeData.scope: out of R2-073 scope; statistical fallback when holdings returns absent
comment only; computation uses real prices
BIST100/30 from real Yahoo constituents, typed SYNTHETIC_PROXY
